question: Whose prosperity is promoted by installing the śrīkara seat in the eastern direction?
premises: The śrīkara seat is installed in the east
The installation has a beneficiary group
Growth is stated for the priests
inference: Installing the śrīkara seat in the east promotes the growth of the priests.
plain_english: In the eastern installation of the śrīkara seat, it is for the growth of the priests.
